repos.title: Repos & workflows
repos.subtitle: Turn on the workflows you want to see in the menu bar. Usually, the deploy of your release branch.
repos.no_account_error: Without a connected account we can't list your repos. Connect one in Account or add a public repo below.
repos.pick_hint: Pick a repo to see its workflows.
repos.pick_folder_title: Choose the folder of a git repository
general.title: General
general.autostart_hint: The app starts on its own and lives in the menu bar.
general.sound_hint: A different sound when a workflow succeeds and when it fails.
general.test_hint: Sends a sample notification; clicking it opens the link on GitHub.
general.polling_hint: Every 15 s while something is running, every 60 s when idle and every 5 min without an account. It slows down on its own if the API rate limit runs low.
general.language_hint: Texts in the menu bar, the list and these settings.
account.title: GitHub account
account.subtitle: The app uses the first account it finds, in this order.
account.no_account: No account: you can only watch public repos and it refreshes every 5 min.
account.gh_hint: Uses your gh auth login session. Nothing else to set up.
account.token_hint: Classic token with the repo scope, or fine-grained with Actions: read. It's stored in the Keychain.
account.oauth_unavailable: Not available in this build: the OAuth app client id was missing at build time.
account.enter_code: Enter this code on the GitHub page that just opened:
account.oauth_hint: Authorize the app in your browser, no tokens to copy.
wf.none: This repo has no GitHub Actions workflows.
wf.filter_hint: Without a filter the latest run is watched, wherever it comes from. Use it if this workflow also runs on, say, pull requests and you don't want them to change the light.
